audit.why: Zoe owns levels 1-2 on poke, Vex takes over from 3 once bubble-dodging tools arrive — content and packet charts agree (Zoe, Zoe, Vex x5); 54.49% WR. Full chart said Skill everywhere; flipped.
Spikes: 3-5 bubble-dodge kit, 6 punishing her walk-ups, first item burst in her cooldown windows, late one-bubble threat. All present.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty MISGENDER lints — Zoe called he/his across tldr, trades, phases, breakdowns, dos/donts titles and six report entries. tradeGood's generic 'answers with a dash' also left her actual dash unnamed (Portal Jump, 11s at rank 1). Missing interaction folded in: recasting Shadow Surge while drowsy hands her a doubled wake-up hit — dash in clean.
audit.why: champ-gender: zoe is she/her. Kit: R Portal Jump dash-flagged 11/8/5s; E 18s hardCC + doubled break damage; P auto-reset tell.
audit.corrected: Pronoun-corrected every flagged field, grounded the good trade in Portal Jump, added the drowsy-dash warning to breakdown.mid.
Added Bubble 18s, Q 8.5s, own W 16s, R 140s.
